[EN] My raiders are ready! If they won't give it to us, we'll take it for ourselves.
[ES] ¡Mis asaltantes están listos! Si no nos lo quieren dar, lo tomaremos por la fuerza.

[EN] If you're part of the federation, you're part of the problem.
[ES] Si eres parte de la federation, eres parte del problema.
